findings.description: Edge functions accepted requests from any origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), exposing them to CSRF and unauthorised cross-origin invocation.
market_intel premium rows could leak to free users via the realtime broadcast channel. Channel split into public + premium with tier-gated subscription.
RLS policy on market_intel now restricts is_premium=true SELECT to subscription_tier IN ('pro','whale') or admin role via get_subscription_tier(auth.uid()).
Defense-in-depth trigger prevent_tier_self_modification on profiles blocks users from mutating their own subscription_tier or trial_ends_at.
chat edge function crashed at boot (RUNTIME_ERROR lineno 0). Added top-level try/catch, env-var validation, /health route, input length caps (≤50 messages, ≤4000 chars).
Tier Preview tool now performs server-side has_role('admin') check on mount and redirects non-admins to /admin with a Not Authorised toast (defense-in-depth).
CORS denial events are now logged server-side (console.error JSON) capturing origin, path, timestamp, and forwarded IP. Client receives only {error:'Forbidden'}.
Data Room panels now run inside per-panel React error boundaries; a render exception or fetch failure in one panel cannot break sibling panels. Retry re-fetches only the failed panel.
Audit confirmed no SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY references exist in any client-side source file (src/, components/, pages/, public/). Service role usage is confined to edge functions.

Audit confirmed no hardcoded API keys for DeFiLlama, GeckoTerminal, Anthropic, PayPal, or Solana RPC in any client-side file. All third-party calls route through edge functions or use the Lovable AI Gateway with server-managed keys.
All public schema tables (profiles, market_intel, subscriptions, user_roles, user_watchlist, feature_requests, sync_jobs, provider_status) have RLS enabled with appropriate ownership-scoped policies.
Tier Preview gained sessionStorage persistence (key 'tier_preview_state') and a labelled tier dropdown (Free/Trial/Pro user). State restores on tab revisit and clears on Reset.
